work.title: Design 004 D03 review status and D04 collection-member validation
authority: Direct user instruction on Design 004 branch e3dd8c9.
Project Redwood invariant: unreconciled differences remain visible and are never forced to balance.

intent.productGoal: Keep the isolated Design 004 review presentation truthful when canonical A/R and collection data vary.
intent.capability: Render an A/R review item as an open finding only when the canonical A/R reconciliation is a difference, and reject canonical API responses with incomplete required collection members before rendering.
architecturalIntent: Design 004 remains a read-only static presentation whose sole financial authority is GET /api/runs/:id.
Validation fails closed at the presentation boundary; it neither repairs nor fabricates malformed canonical facts.
invariants: A matched and assessed A/R control is not represented as an open finding.
Unreconciled controls remain visible rather than being suppressed or balanced locally.
Malformed canonical collections render an explicit unavailable state and receive no local financial fallback.
acceptanceEvidence: Production design.js VM regression tests reproduce matched/assessed A/R and malformed collection-member responses.
Syntax and targeted Design 004 tests execute against the corrected source.
Protected-surface diff review confirms backend, root, next, and workbook surfaces are untouched by this remediation.

decisions.decision: Use the generated review-question status in the selected A/R tag instead of a hard-coded open-finding label.
decisions.rationale: The A/R control's canonical arithmetic state, rather than the existence of another residual or static review styling, determines whether the item is open or in arithmetic agreement.

decisions.decision: Validate required identifying, status, and reference members for gates, reconciliations, findings, and source inventory before shell rendering.
decisions.rationale: A top-level array alone does not prove that the renderer has the canonical identities and statuses it uses to make review claims.

observedBehaviour: A run with a cash difference followed by matched, over-materiality ar-to-gl renders the A/R Review item as Arithmetic agreement and does not emit Derived open finding.
Responses with invalid gate status, reconciliation id or evidence, finding references, or source-inventory hash render Canonical run unavailable and do not render the deal identity.
Challenge G regression continues to keep cash and A/R residuals independent.

evidence.result: Passed: 7 named production-design.js VM regression tests.

divergences.expected: D03/D04 source behaviours are executable and fail closed.
divergences.observed: VM tests prove production renderer markup and loader error paths, but do not establish browser layout, focus traversal, or a live persisted-run response.

learning.recurringPattern: A top-level array check is insufficient where rendering relies on identities and statuses held by its members.
learning.improvementProposal: Formalize a versioned Design 004 GET response schema if this isolated route becomes supported product surface.
durableKnowledge: The selected A/R Review tag must derive from the selected review question status.
Required Design 004 collection members are gate gate/status, reconciliation id/arithmeticStatus/evidence, finding id/status/references, and source-inventory hash/name.
